name: EA inference v2 structural candidate
purpose: Record the candidate implementation before creating a fresh unseen benchmark. Development benchmark scores are not estimates of generalization.
architecture: Existing AST/CFG and intra-procedural data-flow analysis
Conservative candidate lineage with explicit two-distinct-input dependency
Existing role detectors consuming structural facts behind EA-context checks
Optional EA inference remains separate from safety verdict logic

development_benchmark.expected_safety_cases: SAFE EA, UNSAFE EA, SAFE non-EA, UNSAFE non-EA, non-EA loop, callback registration, plus invalid syntax status all matched the evaluator's invariance checks.

validation_set_policy.historical_51_program_set: Previously evaluated under v1 and treated as seen validation data.

known_limitations: Lineage is intra-procedural and uses bounded existing helper summaries; arbitrary interprocedural and heap alias behavior is not modeled.
Unknown indexed accesses share a conservative identity and do not establish that two accesses are distinct candidates.
Dynamic calls, ambiguous branch aliases, and unresolved returns are intentionally not promoted into candidate lineage.
The existing role detectors remain partly syntax-driven; this change adds reusable structural inputs and is not evidence of unseen generalization.
The development set has only 18 programs and has already informed prior detector work; its perfect score is optimistic.
